closure_matrix.what_exists: E36 establishes non-identifiability of hidden kinetic structure from low moments; E27 zero incoming wake is a benchmark condition.
closure_matrix.what_is_missing: A physical norm bound on the propagated homogeneous Vlasov contribution.

closure_matrix.what_exists: E37 gives a sharp endpoint+Lipschitz retarded bound.
closure_matrix.what_is_missing: A physical L_k=sup|partial_t u(k,t)| or stronger dynamical envelope.

closure_matrix.what_exists: E35/E38 give a second-moment low-k profile certificate.
closure_matrix.what_is_missing: Physical radial second moments through the relevant history.

closure_matrix.what_exists: E42 gives a geometric-series sufficient form if a perturbative norm ratio q<1 is known.
closure_matrix.what_is_missing: A physical q or independent second-order force bound on the same halo+environment source.

closure_matrix.what_exists: E40/E41 quantify source-level conditioning and exact response reparameterization freedom.
closure_matrix.what_is_missing: Independent high-z LRG/ELG response calibration and uncertainty bound.

frozen_E28_sign_budget.meaning: Any sufficient physical sign certificate must make the total state-differential closure error across Fminus and Fplus smaller than this absolute benchmark contrast.

illustrative_budget_allocations.warning: These equal splits are bookkeeping examples, not physical priors or measured uncertainties.

minimum_useful_fields: one or more radial second moments or sufficiently rich profile summaries
at least three epochs if possible
next_data_gate_if_returning_to_WSL.purpose: Estimate or bound the history derivative L_k / profile evolution, not merely add endpoint metadata.
next_data_gate_if_returning_to_WSL.recommended_target: small pre-decoded same-object multi-epoch halo dynamical summary, not another whole-column ASDF read
